observations: Photo 0 shows a diagram of a dual-lens surveillance camera with a solar panel on top, mounted on a wall. The camera has two sets of lenses, each with an IR array. Text describes PIR human detection, automatic recording, and push notifications to an app. A man is shown walking in a detection zone, with green boxes indicating motion detection. The image includes a watermark 'ORANGE MOON LTD'.

Photo 1 shows a composite image of a house with a surveillance camera mounted on the wall. The top half is labeled 'Dual-lens Dual-screens Preview' and shows two views: 'Area 1' from a bullet camera and 'Area 2' from a PTZ camera. The bottom half shows the same house with labels 'Bullet Camera' and 'PTZ Camera' pointing to different camera types. The camera in the image has a solar panel and two lenses. The watermark 'ORANGE MOON LTD' is visible.

Both photos are promotional graphics, not real-life photos of the actual product. The camera is depicted in a stylized, illustrative manner. No physical product is shown in hand or in a real environment.

identity.kind: dual-lens 4G surveillance camera with solar panel

claims.evidence: Photo 1 explicitly labels 'Dual-lens Dual-screens Preview' and shows two separate camera views (Bullet Camera and PTZ Camera).

The text in photo 0 mentions '8MP 4K 4G surveillance camera with solar panel', but this is part of a promotional graphic. No physical product is shown to verify these specs. The solar panel is visible in the diagram, but resolution and 4G capability cannot be confirmed from the images.
Photo 0 shows text 'PIR Human Detection' and illustrates a person triggering motion detection with green boxes and alarm notifications. The diagram also labels 'PIR Human Detection / APP wake up'.

claims.claim: Automatic recording and push reminder information to APP
claims.evidence: Photo 0 includes text 'Automatic recording and push reminder information to APP' and shows alarm notifications with timestamps, indicating push alerts.

risks.risk: The camera may not have 8MP 4K resolution or 4G connectivity as claimed
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera's label or packaging showing the model and specifications, or a video showing the camera's live feed resolution and 4G settings in the app.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lower-resolution or non-4G camera, which would reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: The solar panel may be non-functional or insufficient for the camera's power needs
risks.proof: A photo of the solar panel in direct sunlight with the camera powered on, or a video showing the camera operating without a power cable.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-solar-powered camera, reducing its appeal and value.

risks.risk: The dual-lens system may not provide true dual-screen viewing or may be a single camera with two lenses for different purposes (e.g., wide and zoom), not two independent views
risks.proof: A video or screenshot from the app showing two simultaneous, independent live feeds from the same camera unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single-view camera, which would be a major downgrade.

risks.risk: The product may be a generic, unbranded unit with no warranty or support
risks.proof: A photo of the product packaging or a label on the camera showing a brand name or model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic, no-name product, which reduces trust and resale value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the actual camera unit showing the brand, model, and any labels or specifications.
A video or screenshot from the app showing the dual-screen live view feature in action.
A photo of the solar panel in sunlight with the camera powered on, or a video showing the camera operating without a power cable.
A photo of the camera's packaging or any included documentation.
response.reason: The photos are promotional graphics, not real product images. While the claims are supported by the text in the images, critical specifications like 8MP 4K resolution, 4G connectivity, and the functionality of the dual-lens system cannot be verified. The solar panel's functionality and the actual product's brand/model are also unconfirmed. Without real photos or proof of functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately.
